description: client/surface.json: the surface of a Xynolog client: its namespaces and methods, what a worker is handed, its state units, its bus, its storage, its modules and its clock.

shapes.description: Each shape a method returns, with what it is.

via.description: Each way a method reaches what it does, with what it is.

fixtures.description: The values a case names by `{"$fixture": name}`.

shape.description: What the method returns: a key of `shapes`.

via.description: What the method does first: one key of `via`.

content.description: An operation of the content transport.

gateway.description: One of the gateway's own operations.

parameters.description: What the method takes, in order: each parameter by its name, the name a case's `args` give it, with what it is, and whether a caller must give it. Empty when the method takes nothing.

schema.description: What the parameter is. Left out where it is the SDK's own: its error, which no schema states.

$ref.description: The $id of a component, a member within one, or a client type of specs/src/client/types: an object is always one of these, so that it is named.

typeArguments.description: What each of the client type's type parameters is here, by its name: a type parameter of the unit it is given in, one for each the client type's x-xynolog-typeParameters states, and only where it states any.

type.description: The value's type, where no component states one.

minimum.description: The least an integer may be.

format.description: The string's format, where it has one: `date-time` is an RFC 3339 time.

typeParameter.description: A type parameter of the state unit the member is of, by its name: what it is, the unit's maker says.

decided.description: What a value decides: the schema a table names for it.

member.description: A member beside the function, whose value is of an enum.

in.description: The table that names the schema: `takes`, the function's own, by each of the enum's values in its order.

required.description: Whether a caller must give it. A parameter a caller need not give is left out; null is a value, which a caller gives only where the parameter is absent.

absent.description: Whether a caller may give null, for nothing: apart from `required`, which says whether it may be left out. Left out, it is false.

calls.$comment: What the callback is handed, each time it is called.

required.description: Whether a caller must give it.

returns.$comment: What the callback gives back each time it is called: null when it gives nothing.

returns.description: What the call gives its caller once the SDK has unwrapped the reply: the value a promise resolves with, a stream's or a delegation's final value, an upload's created resource, a cache's value, each event of an `events` row (its channel's schema, as bus/registry.json states it) and each job a `claims` row holds. null when the call gives nothing beyond its shape: a promise that resolves with nothing, and every `signal` and `count` row, whose shape says all it gives.

args.$comment: The method's arguments, by its parameters' names, as the wire writes them, with `{"$fixture": name}`: JSON, as it is given.

sends.$comment: What the call sends first: JSON, as it is given.

answers.$comment: What what it sent is answered with, or null: JSON, as it is given.

then.description: What the call sends next, in order.

sends.$comment: What it sends: JSON, as it is given.

content.description: An operation of the content transport.

sends.$comment: What it sends: JSON, as it is given.

correlationId.description: The correlation id the call carries.

record.description: The client type, of client/types and by its name, whose properties are what it holds as data: each is one of its members, which are first, in its order, and take nothing. An SDK's handed has the record whole beside them, a value of that type.

named.description: Each SDK whose ecosystem names the member, with its name and why.

name.description: The SDK's name for the member.

takes.description: Each verb whose job the member settles, with the schema of what it takes.

gives.description: What the member gives its reader, whatever the SDK spells it as: a property or a call, a promise or a callback, a watched value or an observable. The schema it names is Protocol's; the form, the type each SDK holds it in.

schema.$comment: What it holds. Absent when it is the SDK's own: its client, its error.

absent.description: Whether it may hold nothing yet: the SDK's null, or its absent value. Left out when it always holds one.

form.description: A current value, and each change told to its readers.

schema.$comment: What it holds. Absent when it is the SDK's own: its client, its error.

absent.description: Whether it may hold nothing yet: the SDK's null, or its absent value. Left out when it always holds one.

form.description: Each of what it tells, as it tells it, with no current value.

schema.$comment: Each of what it tells. Absent when it is the SDK's own: its error.

form.description: Tells its reader a cancellation, in the SDK's own type of one.
A call that takes what it is given.

parameters.$comment: What it takes, as a method's parameters are stated. Stated with `returns`, or neither is: then what it takes is the SDK's to type (a channel's payload, a cache's persister), and stated nowhere.

returns.$comment: What it gives back: as a method's returns are stated, null when it gives nothing; a stream or a list of a schema; or, where what it gives is no schema but a thing of the surface's own, a handed of `worker` or a function as a member beside it gives.

function.description: The member beside it whose function it gives, which takes and returns what that member's does.

stream.$comment: Each of what it tells, as a member's stream tells it.

list.$comment: What each item is, in the SDK's list.

absent.description: Whether what it returns may be nothing. Left out, it is false: a function that returns nothing at all says so by its null returns.

made.description: What each SDK makes it as.

madeBy.description: Each SDK whose public function makes the unit, where its constructor does not.

typeParameters.description: What its maker decides for it, each a type it is generic over, which its members name as a typeParameter.

name.description: The type parameter, by its name.

wire.description: The typed bus over a client's transport.

made.description: What each SDK makes it as.

storage.description: Where a client keeps text under a key.

made.description: What each SDK makes it as.

modules.description: What each SDK has beside its namespaces.

member.description: The member, as the table spells it.
The member, as the table spells it.

named.description: Each SDK, with its own name for it.

member.description: The member, as the table spells it.

named.description: Each SDK, with its own name for it.

fieldsNamed.description: Each SDK, with its own name for some fields.

member.description: The member, as the table spells it.

named.description: Each SDK, with its own name for it.

names.description: For a constant that is the channels a stream names: the reply channels of each operation of `repliesOf`, then each channel of `channels`, each of bus/registry.json.

repliesOf.description: Each operation, by its request channel, whose reply channels it names.

channels.description: Each other channel it names; none when it names only replies.

value.$comment: The constant's value, where Protocol states it, which every SDK that has the constant holds: JSON by nature, of whatever type the constant is.

clock.description: What a caller controls of an SDK's time and chance.

typeWords.description: The words a type of the source is named by.

outside.description: Each SDK whose caller controls the source from outside it, with how.

takes.description: Each SDK, with each public maker that takes the source and the types it takes it as.
